scope: Unit batch-4 protocol research draft (task-28). Proposal only: not merged into platform/units/catalog.json and not runtime admission. Entries mirror the existing catalog entry shape; evidence URLs are official product pages, the official I2C address index and official m5stack/uiflow-micropython drivers anchored at snapshot 528edd8 (V2.1.5). units.name: Unit CO2L

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SCD4x command + CRC-word protocol at 0x62: 2-byte big-endian commands, responses are 2-byte words each followed by CRC8 (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). SCD41 range is 400-5000 ppm and supports single-shot measurement (0x219D/0x2196).
gaps: SCD40 vs SCD41 identity conflict: CO2 page says SCD40 while CO2L page says SCD41 and the official I2C index lists SCD41 @0x62.
Snapshot CO2LUnit(CO2Unit) vs master CO2LUnit(SCD40) inheritance differs; pin one SHA.
Both driver versions decode temperature from buf[1] instead of buf[4], so guest temperature is not assertable; only CO2 and humidity.
5s periodic measurement timing, CRC and accuracy are NOT RUN.
0x62 conflicts with registered co2 (one Unit per bus).

runtime.required_data_plane: SoC I2C controller transactions to a device-local SCD41 slave at 0x62 implementing the SCD4x command + CRC-word protocol

units.blocker: 复用 0131 US_SCD40（0x62）实现 SCD41 变体：量程改为 400..5000、支持单次测量（0x219D/0x2196）；若需要区分芯片身份可加只读 chip-id（0x40/0x41）。未采集 guest/Device Service 证据 → planned。SCD40 vs SCD41 页面/总表冲突；快照 CO2LUnit(CO2Unit) vs master CO2LUnit(SCD40) 继承结构不同须钉 SHA；两份驱动温度解码都取 buf[1] 而非 buf[4]（既有 bug）→ guest temperature 不可断言，只有 CO2/湿度可断言；5s 周期/CRC/精度 NOT RUN；0x62 与 co2 冲突。
units.input_semantics: Synthetic CO2/temperature/humidity/readiness fixtures encoded into CRC-valid SCD4x response words.
units.output_semantics: Observed guest command words, CRC words and measurement reads; gas-sensor physics are not modeled.
limitations: All default values are synthetic UI/test fixtures, not measured hardware defaults.
This catalog entry alone does not authorize a simulated or functional-PASS claim.

units.name: Unit Weight

protocol.summary: HX711 24-bit ADC bit-pulse interface: guest drives the yellow CLK (25/26/27 pulses per conversion) and reads 24 data bits MSB-first from the white DAT; gain/channel is selected by the extra pulses.

registers.encoding: 24 data bits MSB-first, then 1/3/2 gain pulses; count ^ 0x800000
ready = DAT low; 1us clock half-period; 10SPS output rate

The product-page FAQ calls Weight an I2C unit while the PinMap/description/driver are GPIO/HX711: UNRESOLVED conflict.
Weighing mechanics/load/temperature drift/range are NOT RUN.
